say:1:1223645001:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we plan to develop a side hustle.
say:1:1223645001:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we plan to develop a side hustle.
say:1:1223645001:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we plan to develop a side hustle.

say:2:1223645002:0.text: The pigs in Brineville are the best you can find in Rustport. It took us a lot of money and effort to finally get three.
say:2:1223645002:0.source_cn: 小水村的猪在锈锚港是数一数二的肥，我们凑钱千求万求好不...
say:2:1223645002:0.male: The pigs in Brineville are the best you can find in Rustport. It took us a lot of money and effort to finally get three.
say:2:1223645002:0.female: The pigs in Brineville are the best you can find in Rustport. It took us a lot of money and effort to finally get three.

say:3:1223645003:0.text: But the pigs were ferocious! Not even a few men of strong build could contain them, so they escaped!
say:3:1223645003:0.source_cn: 但那三只猪太彪悍了，几个人高马大的汉子都没拉住猪——让跑了！
say:3:1223645003:0.male: But the pigs were ferocious! Not even a few men of strong build could contain them, so they escaped!
say:3:1223645003:0.female: But the pigs were ferocious! Not even a few men of strong build could contain them, so they escaped!

say:4:1223645004:0.text: Paz's searching for the pigs. If you want to help him out, just go to him.
say:4:1223645004:0.source_cn: 帕斯去找猪了，您要是想帮忙赶猪，去找他就行。
say:4:1223645004:0.male: Paz's searching for the pigs. If you want to help him out, just go to him.
say:4:1223645004:0.female: Paz's searching for the pigs. If you want to help him out, just go to him.

say:0:1223646001:0.text: I believe the pigs have gone to find food. Let's get some gruntgrass for them.
say:0:1223646001:0.source_cn: 这猪应该是没吃饱跑了，给他们弄点猪草吧。
say:0:1223646001:0.male: I believe the pigs have gone to find food. Let's get some gruntgrass for them.
say:0:1223646001:0.female: I believe the pigs have gone to find food. Let's get some gruntgrass for them.

say:0:1223648001:0.text: That's enough. Let's head back and prepare the feed.
say:0:1223648001:0.source_cn: 够了，回去加工一下就是完美的饲料。
say:0:1223648001:0.male: That's enough. Let's head back and prepare the feed.
say:0:1223648001:0.female: That's enough. Let's head back and prepare the feed.

say:1:1223649001:0.text: Are those gruntgrass? Oh, they're in for a treat!
say:1:1223649001:0.source_cn: 您还带了猪草回来？想给它们做吃的？哎呀，它们有福了！
say:1:1223649001:0.male: Are those gruntgrass? Oh, they're in for a treat!
say:1:1223649001:0.female: Are those gruntgrass? Oh, they're in for a treat!

say:2:1223649002:0.text: I've got a pot here, along with some leafmary and minced insect meat that pigs love. Use whatever you need!
say:2:1223649002:0.source_cn: 我这里有锅，还有猪爱吃的韭蓝，虫肉碎，都可以用。
say:2:1223649002:0.male: I've got a pot here, along with some leafmary and minced insect meat that pigs love. Use whatever you need!
say:2:1223649002:0.female: I've got a pot here, along with some leafmary and minced insect meat that pigs love. Use whatever you need!

document:3:87:0.text: A scrumptious blend favored by piglets, containing <style="stress">1 portion of leafmary, 2 portions of insect meat, and 1 portion of gruntgrass</style>.
document:3:87:0.source_cn: 由<style="stress">一捆韭蓝，两份虫肉碎，一份猪草</style>搅拌而成的饲料，是猪仔们的最爱。
document:3:87:0.male: A scrumptious blend favored by piglets, containing <style="stress">1 portion of leafmary, 2 portions of insect meat, and 1 portion of gruntgrass</style>.
document:3:87:0.female: A scrumptious blend favored by piglets, containing <style="stress">1 portion of leafmary, 2 portions of insect meat, and 1 portion of gruntgrass</style>.

say:1:1223650001:1.text: I see... I had no idea there were so many techniques involved!
say:1:1223650001:1.source_cn: 原来如此……猪草加工成猪饲料，还有这么多讲究。
say:1:1223650001:1.male: I see... I had no idea there were so many techniques involved!
say:1:1223650001:1.female: I see... I had no idea there were so many techniques involved!

say:2:1223650002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're so knowledgeable! We're so amateurish compared to you.
say:2:1223650002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're so knowledgeable! We're so amateurish compared to you.
say:2:1223650002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're so knowledgeable! We're so amateurish compared to you.

say:3:1223650003:1.text: From now on, I'll feed the pigs using your method. I'll make sure they grow even bigger than those in Brineville!
say:3:1223650003:1.source_cn: 我以后就用您教的方法来喂养它们，保管让我们的猪肥到超越...

say:3:1223650003:1.female: From now on, I'll feed the pigs using your method. I'll make sure they grow even bigger than those in Brineville!
